title: Drug-matched placebo creates a false background-only exclusion
page_evidence: NCT00816673 is family-ELIGIBLE but its record-level decision is X-CONTRAST, with basis ending 'placebo Circadin; Circadin'.
code_evidence: The fallback removes only full matches of the placebo regex; 'placebo circadin' remains active and matches the intervention keyword. The caller continues to this fallback after a False structural result.
verification: Pinned display and code read; isolated transcribed-function test executed. Current registry response body not obtained.
numerical_qualification: Selection/flow counts require a rebuild. No demonstrated change to the currently served efficacy MD.

title: MYNAP is counted as an eligible adult trial family
page_evidence: NCT02333149 / MYNAP is ELIGIBLE among the displayed 3/16 eligible families.
source_evidence: Original MYNAP protocol specifies ages 6-17 years and ADHD; pinned review protocol requires adults and excludes children/neurodevelopmental populations.
numerical_qualification: Removing this one ineligible family changes the displayed eligible-family count from 3 to 2, holding all other classifications fixed. This is not a validated final census and does not alter the current MD.

title: Extension-phase completers language contaminates the three-week analysis-set label
page_evidence: Declared population is the age 65-80 ITT subgroup, but the compatibility reading labels the row completers using the statement about placebo completers being re-randomized for the extension.
source_evidence: Table 3 supplies three-week first-randomization results. The re-randomization sentence describes entry into the subsequent 26-week extension, not the three-week estimator population.
numerical_qualification: No alteration of the six extracted arm statistics is indicated. This finding concerns incorrect estimator metadata and its witness scope.

title: Subgroup, timepoint and reconstructed-effect scope are not consistently propagated
page_evidence: The protocol explicitly discloses the age 65-80 unadjusted subgroup result; other displays use generic 'end of treatment', adult-insomnia framing and 'the trial’s own effect'.
source_evidence: The verified arm statistics concern the 65-80-year subgroup at three weeks; the published covariate-adjusted effect is -15.6 rather than the reconstructed -17.4 minutes.
numerical_qualification: The subgroup limitation is already disclosed and is not counted as a newly discovered hidden subgroup. The remaining problem is inconsistent propagation to downstream outputs. Neither a different population nor a different estimator should silently replace the declared MD.
